name: Send AI-personalized cold emails from a Google Sheet every morning
description: Every weekday at 08:00 the workflow reads a Google Sheet of leads, skips everyone already contacted and lets Claude write a short, personal email for each new lead from the notes in their row. It sends the email from Gmail, writes Sent, the subject and the time back to the row, waits a minute before the next lead and stops after 20 emails a day.
shortDescription: Claude writes a personal cold email for each new lead in a Google Sheet and Gmail sends 20 of them every weekday morning.
keyFeatures: Runs on a schedule every weekday at 08:00, no manual start
Claude writes each email from the lead's own notes and returns the subject and body as JSON
Leads with anything in the Status column are skipped, so nobody is emailed twice
A daily limit of 20 emails and a 60-second pause between sends keep the volume close to how a person writes
Status, subject and send time are written back to the sheet, so the sheet is the outreach log
prerequisites: A Google Sheet whose first row has the columns, in this order: First Name, Last Name, Email, Title, Company, Industry, City, Notes, Status, Subject, Sent At. Status, Subject and Sent At must stay in columns I, J and K, because the Mark lead as sent step writes to those letters.
Replace YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID in the Read leads and Mark lead as sent steps with the ID from your sheet's URL, and change Sheet1 if your tab has another name
Rewrite the ABOUT THE BUSINESS section of the system prompt in the Write personal email step to describe your company and sender
Adjust the timezone in the trigger and in the Current time step, and the limit of 20 in Daily limit reached?, if needed
idealFor: Founders and small sales teams who already have a list of leads with a few notes on each, and want a short personal first email sent to a handful of them every morning without writing each one by hand.
steps: Read leads: get every row of the sheet, keyed by the header row.
For each lead: skip the row if its Status column is already filled.
Count the emails sent in this run and stop for today once the count passes 20.
Write personal email: Claude writes a subject of at most six words and a plain-text body of 80 to 120 words, based only on the lead's notes.
Send email: Gmail sends the email to the lead.
Mark lead as sent: write Sent, the subject and the current time to columns I, J and K of the row.
Pause 60 seconds, then continue with the next lead.
